title: Chicken soba salad
summary: Chicken soba salad is a japanese dinner built around skinless chicken breast fillets and buckwheat noodles, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Cook skinless chicken breast fillets for Chicken soba salad in a lightly oiled pan until just done, and cook or warm cucumber alongside.
steps.tip: Keep the heat lively so a bowl supper still tastes cooked, not assembled from cold jars.

steps.instruction: Toss buckwheat noodles with lemon or lime, herbs and a pinch of salt.
Pile the protein, salad and any grain into bowls.

Spoon over yoghurt, tahini or the pan juices and serve Chicken soba salad straight away. Taste Chicken soba salad before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.  Serve with the noodles, simmered in salted water until tender.
